confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Japanese pricing, not live listings. Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, meals) are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by season and property. Cocktail and wine are derived from the local beer price relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. FX came from search-result snippets attributed to RBA pages, which I could not open, and some third-party figures conflict with them, so verify the rate against the RBA's F11 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Japanese city basis, benchmarked against Kyoto-area pricing and adjusted downward for Nara's lower-cost hotel and restaurant stock. No named comparable city was used.
